title: Central Library and Digital Knowledge Resources
content: The Central Library spans over 1,500 square meters with an air-conditioned reading hall seating 400 students. Houses over 65,000 books, 120 national and international print journals, and digital subscriptions to IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, and DELNET. The library features automated RFID book borrowing and 24/7 digital repository access.
